title: eludite.browser.navigate input
description: Navigate a tab (default: the active one) to `url`, or go `back`, `forward` or `reload`, or `stop` loading (give exactly one of `url` and `action`), and wait until the page reaches `wait_until` (default `load`). Answers the final url, the title, the main document's HTTP status, the new page_generation (refs from before are stale) and how many console errors the page logged during the load. A navigation error (`net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED`, ...) fails the command and names it; not reaching `wait_until` in `wait_ms` is not a failure (`timed_out: true`). When the browser has no tab, opens one (launching the browser if needed). Permission class execute; a `url` off the allowed origins (the solution policy's `browser.origins`: localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1], files under the workspace and the workspace's launch urls by default) makes the call dangerous, which prompts (ADR-0009); `back`, `forward`, `reload` and `stop` stay execute; `stop` answers at once. Next: eludite.browser.read_page, eludite.browser.screenshot, eludite.browser.console.
x-eludite-escalates: Dangerous when `url` is off the allowed origins (the solution policy's `browser.origins`).

url.description: An absolute URL with a scheme.

action.description: History, reload, or `stop` (stop loading: the Web Browser window's Stop button and Escape) instead of a url.

wait_until.description: `load` (default): the load event. `domcontentloaded`: DOMContentLoaded. `network_idle`: the load event, then no request in flight for 500 ms. `none`: answer as soon as the navigation started.

wait_ms.description: How long to wait, in milliseconds (default 30000).

tab.description: The tab: its id from eludite.browser.tabs (`t1`, `t2`, ...). Default: the active tab (the one last opened or selected).
